SELECT
    CASE WHEN bs.b1_cnt > 1071 THEN bs.b1_ext_tax ELSE bs.b1_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN bs.b2_cnt > 39161 THEN bs.b2_ext_tax ELSE bs.b2_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN bs.b3_cnt > 29434 THEN bs.b3_ext_tax ELSE bs.b3_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN bs.b4_cnt > 6568 THEN bs.b4_ext_tax ELSE bs.b4_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN bs.b5_cnt > 21216 THEN bs.b5_ext_tax ELSE bs.b5_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket5
FROM (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS b1_cnt,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS b1_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS b1_net_paid_inc_tax,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS b2_cnt,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS b2_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS b2_net_paid_inc_tax,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS b3_cnt,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS b3_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS b3_net_paid_inc_tax,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS b4_cnt,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS b4_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS b4_net_paid_inc_tax,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS b5_cnt,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS b5_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS b5_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
) AS bs
JOIN reason AS r ON r.r_reason_sk = 1
